$comment: One table of malformed and well-formed calls, driven through BOTH validators: tests/unit/test_validation.py and packages/server-node/test/validation.test.mjs read this file and assert the same verdict and the same sentence. The same pattern as value-encoding.json, and for the same reason — two hand-written copies of a rule are two rules. `error` is the exact message the call must be refused with, sourced from contract/tools.json -> errors; `error: null` means the call must be accepted. Nothing here touches an OPC UA server: these are checks on the request, made before a session is reached.

cases.name: a required array argument that is absent
cases.error: read_opcua_nodes requires node_ids

cases.name: a required array argument that is empty
cases.error: read_opcua_nodes requires a non-empty node_ids array

cases.name: one node id passed bare instead of as a list
cases.error: read_opcua_nodes argument node_ids must be an array of strings

cases.name: a node id that is not a string names the element that is wrong
cases.error: read_opcua_nodes argument node_ids[1] must be a string

cases.name: a well-formed read
a write entry missing its node id
cases.error: write_opcua_nodes requires nodes[0].node_id

cases.name: a write entry missing its value
cases.error: write_opcua_nodes requires nodes[0].value

cases.name: the second write entry is the broken one
cases.error: write_opcua_nodes requires nodes[1].value

cases.name: a data_type given as a number rather than an OPC UA type name
cases.error: write_opcua_nodes argument nodes[0].data_type must be a string

cases.name: one write passed as an object rather than a one-element list
cases.error: write_opcua_nodes argument nodes must be an array of objects

cases.name: a write of false is a value, not an absent one
a write of zero is a value, not an absent one
a write with an explicit data_type
a tool with no required arguments accepts an empty call
a depth passed as a string
cases.error: browse_opcua_nodes argument depth must be an integer

cases.name: a whole-valued float is an integer, because JSON has one number type
a fractional depth is not
cases.error: browse_opcua_nodes argument depth must be an integer

cases.name: true is not an integer, in JSON or here
cases.error: browse_opcua_nodes argument depth must be an integer

cases.name: a flag passed as a word
cases.error: browse_opcua_nodes argument include_values must be a boolean

cases.name: the second of two required arguments is absent
cases.error: call_opcua_method requires method_node_id

cases.name: method arguments passed as a bare value
cases.error: call_opcua_method argument arguments must be an array

cases.name: method arguments are untyped, so anything in the list is accepted
a publishing interval passed as a word
cases.error: subscribe_opcua_nodes argument publishing_interval must be a number

cases.name: an integer is a number
an empty subscription cancel
cases.error: unsubscribe_opcua_nodes requires a non-empty subscription_ids array

cases.name: a history node id passed as a number
cases.error: read_opcua_history argument node_id must be a string

cases.name: a fractional read limit
cases.error: read_events argument limit must be an integer

cases.name: an alarm acknowledgement with no event id
cases.error: acknowledge_alarm requires event_id

cases.name: an alarm acknowledgement with only the event id
